Raised relief is an explicit teaching convention whereas these specimens preserve negative epirelief. No inferred tracemaker, behavior or new dating asserted; slab scale/composition and colors are artistic.

concept_decisions: Concept pixels inspected. Keep small U-like recurvatures and dark core/pale mantle contrast; correct the concept halo that looks like an outer ring on one side by surrounding the core on both sides with a continuous low shoulder, not a hollow lined pipe. About7-9 U lobes in2-3 loosely aligned groups with gaps; core width1.0-1.4mm, mantle width about0.5-1.0mm each side. Encode both core ridge and lower wider mantle shoulder geometrically so clay shows their relation. Avoid large thick horseshoes, disconnected pebbles and zebra cross stripes. No visible spreite added because not observed in selected Waverly source. Host slab surface remains quiet; core and mantle join within one relief cross-section without coincident visible skins.
